---
title: "Quiz Score Tracker"
format: dashboard
    
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(ggplot2)
library(shiny)



Groups <- c("Group 1", "Group 2", "Group 3", "Group 4", "Group 5","Group 6", "Group 7", "Group 8", "Group 9", "Group 10", "Group 11", "Group 12")
n_questions <- 15
max_points_per_question <- 10
scores_file <- "quiz_scores.csv"
```

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

uiOutput("question_label")

lapply(Groups, function(s) {
  numericInput(
    inputId = paste0("score_", gsub(" ", "_", s)),
    label = s,
    value = 0,
    min = 0,
    max = max_points_per_question
  )
})

actionButton("submit_question", "Submit Question", class = "btn-primary")
actionButton("reset", "Reset All", class = "btn-danger")
uiOutput("progress_text")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill

plotOutput("score_plot")
tableOutput("score_table")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

current_q <- reactiveVal({
  if (file.exists(scores_file)) {
    mat <- as.matrix(read.csv(scores_file, row.names = 1))
    answered <- which(apply(mat, 2, function(col) any(col != 0)))
    if (length(answered) == 0) 1 else max(answered) + 1
  } else { 1 }
})

scores <- reactiveVal({
  if (file.exists(scores_file)) {
    mat <- as.matrix(read.csv(scores_file, row.names = 1))
    colnames(mat) <- paste0("Q", 1:n_questions)
    mat
  } else {
    mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(Groups), ncol = n_questions)
    rownames(mat) <- Groups
    colnames(mat) <- paste0("Q", 1:n_questions)
    mat
  }
})

output$question_label <- renderUI({
  if (current_q() <= n_questions)
    h4(paste("Enter points for Question", current_q()))
  else
    h4("All questions complete!")
})

output$progress_text <- renderUI({
  q <- current_q()
  if (q <= n_questions) {
    tagList(
      p(paste("Question", q, "of", n_questions)),
      div(style = "background:#ddd; border-radius:4px;",
        div(style = paste0("width:", round((q-1)/n_questions*100), "%;",
          "background:#0021A5; height:12px; border-radius:4px;"))
      )
    )
  } else {
    p(strong("Quiz complete! 🎉"), style = "color:green;")
  }
})

observeEvent(input$submit_question, {
  q <- current_q()
  if (q > n_questions) return()
  mat <- scores()
  for (s in Groups) {
    id <- paste0("score_", gsub(" ", "_", s))
    mat[s, q] <- input[[id]]
  }
  scores(mat)
  write.csv(mat, scores_file)
  for (s in Groups) {
    updateNumericInput(session, paste0("score_", gsub(" ", "_", s)), value = 0)
  }
  current_q(q + 1)
})

observeEvent(input$reset, {
  mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(Groups), ncol = n_questions)
  rownames(mat) <- Groups
  colnames(mat) <- paste0("Q", 1:n_questions)
  scores(mat)
  current_q(1)
  if (file.exists(scores_file)) file.remove(scores_file)
  for (s in Groups) {
    updateNumericInput(session, paste0("score_", gsub(" ", "_", s)), value = 0)
  }
})

output$score_plot <- renderPlot({
  mat <- scores()
  df <- data.frame(Group = Groups, Total = rowSums(mat))
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = Total, fill = Group)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Total), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
    ylim(0, n_questions * max_points_per_question * 1.1) +
    labs(title = paste("Scores after", max(0, current_q()-1), "of", n_questions, "questions"),
         x = NULL, y = "Total Points") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
})

output$score_table <- renderTable({
  mat <- scores()
  df <- as.data.frame(mat)
  colnames(df) <- paste0("Q", 1:n_questions)
  df$Total <- rowSums(mat)
  df$Group <- Groups
  df[, c("Group", paste0("Q", 1:n_questions), "Total")]
})
```
